exposure: Spinal needle tip orientation (sharp tip opening, laterally, caudally)
spinal needle opening right or left laterally
cohort: 300 patients aged 18-45 years who underwent cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Orienting the spinal needle opening caudally during spinal anesthesia for Cesarean section reduced the incidence of postdural puncture headache compared to sharp tip opening or lateral orientation.
